title: Insomnia TCM Mining — Reproducible Experiment Package for Apriori Association Rule and Complex Network Analysis of Insomnia Traditional Chinese Medicine Prescriptions
description: An end-to-end, single-command reproducible pipeline of eleven Python scripts, a Makefile and a continuous-integration workflow. Starting from two minimum-necessary CSV inputs containing only the fields prescription_id and herb, the pipeline regenerates every numerical result, eight figures and six tables. Designed so that any third party can independently verify the reported numbers via a single make all command.
